note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as carried in the kit starter (Exophase / PSNProfiles). Every guide below is written in my own words and cites its source.

trophies.guide: This one unlocks by itself once the other 54 are done, so treat it as the finish line rather than a task: work through the roadmap below, keep the Chapter 1 save described under Positive Mental Attitude, and the platinum pops after the last trophy. Expect a long road of roughly 200 hours, not a hard one.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss here: it pops as the story moves forward.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 1. Before the chapter closes, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude and keep a manual save from the start of the chapter, because that spot never comes back. The trophy itself sometimes pops as the next chapter begins.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. While you are here, the Chapter 2 missions open the garage properties and the Scooter Bros app, so start Little Boxes and On the Spot as soon as they unlock instead of leaving them for later.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Two things deserve attention inside this chapter: the street-racing strand against Yago runs on a timer, so save first and race at once, and the mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs hands you the Snap Gun you will want later for Sneakthief.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Play Chapter 4 to its end. Near the end of this chapter the optional mission That's Where The Money Is opens the bank vaults, which is the door to Maximum Withdrawal, so do not skip it.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Put a manual save down just before it starts: after the credits everything outside the story stays open, but a clean pre-finale save is the safety net if anything goes wrong.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It comes up in the natural flow of the story, so just keep playing and it pops on completion.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A straight story trophy: finish the mission and it is yours.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Another mission trophy that needs no preparation; it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finish the mission and the trophy follows automatically.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The airport setting is worth remembering later: the same airport is where Catch Me If You Can happens, at gates E3 and E4.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A story trophy with no extra steps: play the mission through.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion once the story is done, and work you did earlier still counts toward it. The heavy parts are 300 stunts, 8 bank vaults, 39 illegal operations, 200 of the 277 vehicle models and 70 of the 80 challenges, so chip away at those during the story instead of leaving them all for the end.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts: stunt jumps, flying under bridges, knife-edge flights and base jumps all count. Do them whenever you pass a jump or a bridge rather than grinding them all at once, and remember full completion wants 300, so the extra 50 are worth doing while you are at it.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each of the 9 activity types once. You do not need to be good at any of them or finish them, just try one of each: a race, a fishing challenge, an arcade game, a drone race, a shooting range session and the rest of the list as you meet them around Leonida.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across the game's 2 ranges. Learn each range's scoring first, then work through them one at a time; a steady aim and reloading between waves matter more than speed.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each spot is its own race, so visit them one by one and learn the course before pushing for the win; losing a race costs nothing but the retry.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The key word is different: repeating the same race does not add to the count, so spread your wins across the race types and locations, including the street races you meet in the story strands.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take the challenge when it is offered, watch the line tension, and reel steadily instead of yanking; one clean win is all it takes.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game from start to end. Pick the cabinet you enjoy most and play it through; any completed arcade game counts, so choose the shortest one if you just want the trophy.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Andy's strand does not count toward the 8 strands of Strangers & Freaks, since it has this trophy of its own, and it stays open after the story ends.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Like the other side-character finales, it remains available after the credits, so there is no rush, but do not confuse it with the stranger strands.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Billy's strand is one of the three that do not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it carries its own trophy, and it stays open after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Watch the count: the strands of Andy, Billy and Tyrone do not count here, because each has its own trophy, so you need 8 from the other strangers. Check the progress counter shown for each strand. One strand is time-sensitive: Yago's street racing in Chapter 3 shows an hourglass, so save first and race as soon as it appears, or that strand may slip away.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. It stays available after the story, so fold it into your post-story cleanup if you have not done it yet.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Tyrone's strand is excluded from Strangers & Freaks, so it only pays off through this trophy, and it remains open after the credits.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. This is the one trophy you can truly miss, so read this carefully: the first spot is the balcony of Jason's house, where Lucia meditates on the morning after the mission Down to Earth, and it disappears for good once Chapter 1 ends. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 until the trophy pops. Later spots show as purple icons when you get close, and meditating with your partner along should count for both characters at once.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. This is Jason-only hunting work: follow Bret's strand, find the target animal, and take a clean head or heart shot so the carcass stays pristine. A messy shot can spoil the hunt, so line it up before firing.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Finish 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered around Leonida, so pick up every set you pass while doing other things and trade or hunt down the stragglers at the end; a set only counts once every card in it is found.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Make it a habit: whenever you arrive somewhere new, open the WAiNK app and mark the spot. Scanning a vehicle with the app also counts as discovering it, which helps Whip It Good at the same time.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges, tracked under Progress, then Challenges. Work through the easy ones first and keep an eye on the list as you play; full completion wants 70 of the 80 challenges, so the 50 for this trophy are a milestone on the way, not the end.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and get fully out of the red heat zone. The trophy only pops once you are clear of the heat zone itself, not just out of the flashing search area. The easiest setup is a bank vault escape with your partner, which can earn this at the same moment.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops one after another without letting the wanted level drop away between them. If the stars fade and only the red heat zone is left, the chain breaks and you start over. It can take about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop before the trophy pops, so do not panic if it is not instant.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Driving or scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan everything you pass. Full completion wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning long after this trophy pops.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aim you trigger with L3 and R3 while aiming. A good spot is the guards at an illegal operation: take an assault rifle, start Focus, and work through five targets before it runs out. Adrenaline stretches Focus out, which makes the window easier.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA airport; the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Save first, because the police arrive fast, then get in, take off and fly about a kilometre away from the airport for the trophy to pop.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a military Rhino tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Drive up, climb in, and the trophy is yours; expect a heavy police response once you roll out.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being spotted. The clean way in needs the Snap Gun from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: it opens the locked back door, while kicking the door in trips the alarm. Once inside, find the safe code note, open the safe, and slip out the way you came. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good target for the attempt.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open up through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4, where you tail an armored van to a large bank; bring your partner, because one person cannot carry all the bags alone. Walking in earns a 4-star wanted level, so plan the getaway before you go in. Full completion wants all 8 vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop the truck, take the money, and get clear of the heat zone: like Hot Together, this one only pops once you are fully out of the red zone, not just out of the flashing search area.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel, so drive, fly and walk into every corner, including the islands and the far southwest. Check the map for blank patches and visit them one by one.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. You only need one per gang for the trophy, but full completion wants all 39 operations, so keep a list of which gangs you have hit and return for the rest later.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beachfront, find a spot with a view over the water, and enjoy the drink; it is a small moment trophy, so take it slowly and it will pop.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Pick a showroom, get into a car inside, and drive straight out through the glass. It is a loud exit, so be ready for the police to notice.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play at Kingpin Bowling, the Kolt and Associates bowling alley, which is an illegal operation you first visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs for the job: take the 3 key valuables, the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table and the office safe contents, blowing the safe open with a Sticky Bomb, then escape the police. Leaving something behind is not a problem, because the operation comes back later.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Get both Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train together: your partner trains alongside you, so work out with them regularly and both of your Strength stats will climb to the top.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Rack up 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies, fights and other crimes all feed the count, so it builds naturally as you play through the robberies and operations this guide already asks for; it is a long grind only if you try to rush it in one sitting.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. This one pops when something you failed once works the second time around, so if an attempt goes wrong, try it again instead of reloading an old save.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange out in Leonida. Keep your eyes open while exploring, especially in odd corners of the map, and this one finds you when you stumble on one of the game's weird moments.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by. Get a vehicle moving, lean out with a melee weapon, and bowl your target over as you pass. A slow drive past a pedestrian on a quiet street makes the timing easy.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. The total is cumulative: Marked Bills come in from bank and payday-loan jobs, so keep running those jobs and pass the bills through your contacts until the quarter-million is reached.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every shop in the game, so normal buying during the story plus the garage properties and gear for the other trophies will get you most of the way there; top it up with big purchases at the end if you are short.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties through the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The total bill is around $160,000, and garages given to you by the story do not count, so you need to buy all 8 yourself.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app opens through the Chapter 2 mission Moses: take a stolen car to Moses, respray it, then register it. From Chapter 3 you can also do it at a Pay 'n' Spray with a standard tracker fitted. Each car needs a free garage space, so keep a slot open when you go hunting for cars to register.
trophies.name: On the Spot
